xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #6040

plan.title: bug(pre-pr): pre-PR is the Read-Write-Lint-Diff-Loop plus verify:ac on the active xBrief; drop the post-loop full task check and the coverage run

narratives.Description: bug(pre-pr): pre-PR is the Read-Write-Lint-Diff-Loop plus verify:ac on the active xBrief; drop the post-loop full task check and the coverage run
narratives.Overview:
- relieves: P1 — Set `merge_chokepoint.required` to false while keeping the row in `PRE_PR_PHASES` so a green required-set without that row publishes `outcome: pass` with a `pushBinding`.
- relieves: P2 — Drop `--coverage` from `lint_iteration.command` and set `coverage_headroom.required` to false so no pre-PR step runs or requires coverage.
- relieves: P3 — Edit pack-source pre-PR skill and `packs:render` so agents run only Expected 6 scoped loop commands with `tsc` kept in CI, stop prompting post-loop full check and coverage including reversing the soften-forbid line, and note a missing per-path linter visibly then continue without recording that absence as a failing required Vitest observation (Expected 7).
- relieves: P4 — Keep conflict-resolve and behind-rebase local full gate on skill lines 67 and 70, flip line 68 so plain pre-push no longer requires the local full gate, leave `ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_COMMANDS` unchanged, and keep `verify:ac -- <active-xbrief>` as a required local skill step.
- Footnote: AGENTS.md merge-chokepoint clarify; CHANGELOG; re-point required-order tests; optional-red still fails if observed; leave lint_iteration skip arms unchanged; release+pin before #6025 re-enable.
narratives.Labels: bug, process, area:skills, dogfood, design-critique:ingest-ready, core-capabilities, promise:gates
narratives.UserStory: As an agent running pre-PR, I want RWDL plus verify:ac on the active xBrief without a post-loop full task check or coverage run, so review-fix cycles stay scoped to the change.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Prefer-A Bound 6610208589: soften merge_chokepoint and coverage_headroom to required:false; drop --coverage from lint_iteration; rewrite pack-source pre-PR skill + packs:render; keep conflict-resolve/behind-rebase full gate; CHANGELOG + AGENTS footnote.
